title: Turn a screenshot into a full cinematic video with Claude Code
description:
video-shotcraft is a free open source skill for Claude Code and Codex with 5,130 GitHub stars that builds cinematic product demo videos using Remotion. It ships with 152 shot recipe cards, 209 browsable motion previews and a production-ready template, so you give it a screenshot, describe the shot you want, and it storyboards, animates and renders the whole thing as real code rather than generated footage, which keeps your interface text and logo pixel accurate.

Get the full guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1W24GMA7B4Irn9nCKZV005wmgUwrAQiTgZ0FH_fBjHU8/edit?usp=sharing

#Shorts #ClaudeCode #ProductVideo
